title: printConfigShow now resolves readPhaseModel + readPhaseBackend per row (12 file…
body: printConfigShow now resolves readPhaseModel + readPhaseBackend per row (12 file reads of the same project.toml for a 6-row table). Harmless for a one-shot --show, but a single loadConfig + in-memory resolution would be cleaner if this ever moves onto a hot path. Non-blocking.
